messages.text:
I have enough of the stable contract to start writing the port: option parsing must mimic eza’s custom parser, while listing can be implemented against the local filesystem without calling the official binary.

I’ll add `./executable`, keep differential verification scripts under `.tura/script`, and then iterate on mismatches from live oracle runs.
